analysis_families.question: Does restricting IBS integration to days 730–1095.75 alter the original matched comparisons?
analysis_families.input: Frozen original predictions, original outer assignments, original training-derived censoring distributions.
analysis_families.integration_grid: 730 plus each original nine-point grid time strictly greater than 730, through 1095.75; survival at 730 linearly interpolated from frozen original-grid survival.
analysis_families.contrasts: All original 20: eight MRI/plasma, seven PET, three tau, two stronger clinical comparisons.
analysis_families.adjustment: A separate Bonferroni family of 20 for the new late-window IBS contrasts only.
analysis_families.claim_limit: A changed averaging interval, not first-onset prediction, external validation or repetition of model development.

analysis_families.question: Reconstruct subset-specific training Kaplan–Meier null IBS and tau IPA from the frozen evaluation populations.
analysis_families.inputs: Original per-fold training outcomes and evaluated participants/predictions; no model refit.
analysis_families.ipa: 100*(1 - fold-size-weighted IBS_model/fold-size-weighted IBS_null), before display rounding.
analysis_families.validation: Reconcile existing MRI null and all already-reported IPA values; exact denominator and scales recorded.

analysis_families.question: Assess the claim that pre-standardizing a single expert’s inputs before its already-standardizing component Cox pipeline changes scaling.
analysis_families.scope: Deterministic preprocessing invariance on actual frozen feature frames, across source components and eligible modality subsets.
analysis_families.transforms: Compare imputation+StandardScaler on raw inputs against component-affine-standardized inputs followed by the same training-only imputation+StandardScaler.
analysis_families.claim_limit: Does not test jointly tuned pooled OOF fusion and does not establish performance equivalence across different feature representations.

reporting_reconciliations: Extract exact within-fold pair-weighted concordance point estimates and intervals already computed for tau and the 220-person overlap; verify every draw remains estimable.
Expose existing sex-specific paired IBS diagnostics with nominal 95% intervals and no claim of sex equivalence or a tested interaction.
Verify actual current Word/PDF equation visibility, native superscript footnotes, repeating table headers and figure placement before accepting extraction-based complaints.
Correct reference metadata against primary records without changing source identity or target-journal citations.
publication_scope: Aggregate-only outputs and source code; no subject records, predictions, weights or private membership digests leave the authorized research root.
